pidfile.description: Path to write the process PID file.

socket_dir.description: Directory for Unix domain sockets (e.g., for QEMU integration).

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: debug, info, notice, warning, error.

log_file.description: Optional path to redirect logs. If empty, logs go to stdout.

tap_ifname.description: Name of the TAP interface (e.g., 'tap0'). Use 'auto' for automatic naming.

bridge.description: Optional Linux bridge to attach the TAP interface to (e.g., 'br0').

bridge_mac.description: MAC address for the bridge-facing side of the TAP device (auto-generated if omitted).

macvtap_ifname.description: Name of the underlying interface (e.g., 'eth0') for MACVTAP mode.

socket_path.description: Unix socket path for socket-based TAP mode (e.g., QEMU -netdev socket).

ip6_prefix.description: IPv6 prefix for the guest network (e.g., 'fd00::/64'). Must be unique per instance.

ip4_prefix.description: IPv4 prefix for the guest network (e.g., '192.168.1.0/24').

ip4_gw.description: IPv4 gateway address (router) for the guest network.

ip6_gw.description: IPv6 gateway address (router) for the guest network.

dns_server.description: Upstream DNS server IP addresses for the guest.

dns_search.description: DNS search domains to append to unqualified hostnames.

port_forward.description: List of port forwarding rules. Each rule forwards traffic from host port to guest (IP:port).

nat.description: Enable NAT for outbound guest traffic (required if guest is not on routed subnet).

nat_table.description: Name of the NAT table (for iptables/nftables).

user.description: Run passt as this user (for security).

group.description: Run passt as this group (for security).

no_new_privs.description: Drop privileges to prevent privilege escalation (setprctl(PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS, 1)).
